canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
Reparo mends certain damaged objects, but mending a broken wand's exterior does not restore its magic.

startAssumptions: Learner: adult, magically eligible, owns intact wand, knows Lumos and Nox.
Visitor: adult, nonmagical, owns wand, lacks magical source/learned casting.
Setting: dim storage room; actor can leave freely.

actions.name: Cast Lumos
actions.preconditions: owns wand AND magically eligible AND knows Lumos
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 source effect; P1 design eligibility

actions.name: Cast Nox
actions.preconditions: owns wand AND magically eligible AND knows Nox
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 source effect; P1 design eligibility

actions.name: Cast Reparo
actions.preconditions: owns wand AND magically eligible AND knows Reparo
actions.sourceVsDesign: H2 source effect; P1 design (learner lacks knowledge)

counterexamples: Visitor with wand attempts Lumos: refusal (no magical source).
Learner attempts Reparo: refusal (not learned per P1).
Visitor attempts Reparo: refusal (no magical source).
Reparo used on broken wand: physical fix only, no magic restored (H2).
futureWitness: Persist identity and light state via save policy
numericalPolicy: No numerical costs, durations, energy, or cooldowns defined per H1, H2, and O1.
